I’ve been farming these 5 mu in Quzhou for 30 years. I finished middle school and came straight back to the land. My old man taught me, and I learn by watching what works on my neighbors’ fields. I don’t trust fancy advice unless I saw it grow in someone else’s plot first.

This year I’ll keep 3 mu in winter wheat that turns into summer maize, and 2 mu in cotton. That’s what I did last year, and it paid out fine. Fertilizer is expensive now — compound fertilizer is over 200 yuan a bag and urea is about 120 — but I remember 2019 when I tried to save money by cutting back. The yield dropped hard and I lost more than I saved. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting a bit of fertilizer is just a cost. My wife works off-farm in town, so labor is tight. I manage most of the field work myself, maybe hiring one person for a day during wheat harvest.

For the **wheat**: I ploughed and planted last October with one 50-jin bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base. Now it’s waking up. I will top dress with 30 jin of urea per mu at green-up. I will irrigate three times total through the season — spring green-up, jointing, and grain filling. I will spray pesticides twice for aphids and rust. I expect about 900 jin per mu if the weather is normal.

For **cotton**: In late April I will rotary till the 2 mu and plant an improved variety — the same seeds from the supply store that my neighbor Lao Wang used last year, his cotton did well. I will put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu as base, then top dress with urea twice, once at flowering and once when the bolls are setting. Cotton drinks a lot of water and the bollworm is vicious here, so I will irrigate four times and spray pesticides five times. I hope for 500 jin of seed cotton per mu.

For **maize**: After I cut the wheat in early June, I will plant hybrid maize directly into the wheat stubble with no-tillage. No point ploughing again. I will put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting, then one top dressing of urea when the plants are knee-high. I will irrigate twice and spray for armyworm twice. Hybrid maize grows fast and strong — I expect about 1,100 jin per mu.
